ValidationRule.description: Required Fields when NDA or MSA type is selected
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (ISPICKVAL(Type__c,"MSA") || ISPICKVAL(Type__c,"MSA with NDA") || ISPICKVAL(Type__c,"NDA")) && (ISBLANK( Date_Signed__c ) || ISBLANK( Signer__c ) || ISBLANK( Account_Name__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Date Signed, Signer, and Account Name are required for NDAs and MSAs.
